faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Pudukkottai recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DHS Pudukkottai Various Contractual Posts is 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 54 vacancies announced for various contractual posts by the District Health Society Pudukkottai.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 65 years for all the posts.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary for each post, ranging from 8th Standard Pass to MBBS with internship and specialized degrees like DPH/MPH, B.Sc./M.Sc. Audiology, and B.Sc. Nursing/DGNM.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 11,000 to Rs. 63,000 per month, depending on the post and its responsibilities.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the DHS Pudukkottai recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of District Health Society Pudukkottai, which is https://pudukkottai.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the start date for the application process?
faq.answer: The application process starts on 10 September 2026.
